manual.item_hatch.line2: {0}Item hatches are a simple way to retrieve an item from an inventory.{1}
manual.item_hatch.line3: Right-clicking them with an empty hand will retrieve the first stack of items from the inventory it is attached to.{0}
manual.item_hatch.line4: This makes for easy access to frequently used construction materials stored in chests or crates, and is exceedingly helpful for directly retrieving items from a {0}Silo{1}.
